newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading in CEF, ITC, Paul-ITC suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in CEF, ITC, Paul-ITC suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of CEF Concord Holdings Ltd, International Tak Cheung Holdings Ltd, and Paul Y-ITC Construction Holdings Ltd were suspended on Monday afternoon pending an announcement, the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.
Shares of construction concern CEF Concord ended the morning session at HK$1.09, up HK$0.03.
Civil engineering group International Tak Cheung Holdings shares were unchanged at HK$2.20.
Paul Y-ITC shares rose HK$0.02 to HK$1.84.
Brokers said the suspension was expected to be related to a share placement of 450 million new CEF Concord shares at HK$0.90 per share, raising capital to fund its purchase of assets.
In October, International Tak Cheung said it was holding preliminary negotiations with CEF Concord that could result in a reorganisation.
CEF Concord is 51 percent held by Fortune Leader Ltd, a company which in turn is about 12.1 percent owned by Paul Y-ITC Construction.
Paul Y-ITC is 35.6 percent held by International Tak Cheung.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
